root_cause.text: The non-XDR key preparsing path in rxrpc_preparse() fails to validate that the ticket length does not exceed AFSTOKEN_RK_TIX_MAX, allowing an oversized ticket to later cause a WARN_ON in rxrpc_read() due to exceeding AFSTOKEN_LENGTH_MAX.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the missing check `if (v1->ticket_length > AFSTOKEN_RK_TIX_MAX)` in the non-XDR path of rxrpc_preparse(), and the CVE description confirms that this absence of validation permits an unprivileged user to provide a very large ticket length, triggering the warning.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add boundary check to reject RxRPC keys with ticket length exceeding the maximum allowed.
intent_record.what: Added a check that sets ret to -EKEYREJECTED and jumps to error label if v1->ticket_length exceeds AFSTOKEN_RK_TIX_MAX, inserted after security_index validation and before ticket_length usage.
intent_record.how: Prevents processing of keys with oversized tickets, avoiding potential buffer overflows or excessive memory allocation, and returns the appropriate error code.
